Subject: Invoice routing & VAT for Redwood listing (SKU: RINF-ML-02)

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads up on an invoicing issue for the April marketplace charge for SKU RINF-ML-02. Our accounting team received an invoice from Redwood Inc (your seller entity) instead of Acme Cloud Ltd (our buying entity). Because Acme is VAT-registered in Ireland (VAT IE12345678), this incorrectly routed invoice is causing our systems to apply VAT at source rather than the reverse-charge that should apply between two EU businesses.

I attached our VAT certificate for verification (acme_vat_certificate.pdf). Can Redwood reissue the invoice to Acme Cloud Ltd and mark it as reverse-charge (zero VAT) so our AP can process a credit? Also, for US-sourced marketplace credits the legal team is asking for a completed W-9 for our US affiliate; please confirm whether you need a scanned W-9 or a digitally signed DocuSign.

We want to avoid blocking the renewal approval — can you confirm next steps and an ETA for a corrected invoice?

Thanks,
Sarah
